statement:
The claim record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000 for CL-7712 under Policy PL-40.

However, Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000, so I will pay the policy maximum.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000, so I will pay the policy maximum," identifying the approved 480,000 as exceeding the stated limit and giving the correct amount.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
